combination_rule: CANNOT_DETERMINE if frozen misses (a) on >= 2 seeds; else INCOMPLETE if any arm has < 5 seeds; else HOLDS-REENCODE if reencode keeps the bar (HOLDS-BOTH if stored also keeps it); else HOLDS-STORED-ONLY if stored keeps it; else NEITHER. outcome PASS iff HOLDS-*.

interpretation.label: neither
interpretation.summary: N2 at post 1200, seeds [811, 812, 813, 814, 815]: verdict NEITHER. frozen (a) 4/5, reencode keeps bar False, stored keeps bar False.

preconditions.name: control_arm_meets_gate_a
preconditions.description: positive control: the frozen-encoder arm (= the W3 member-gate config) must meet (a) on >= n-1 seeds, else the decision rule returns CANNOT_DETERMINE (pre-registered rule 1)
preconditions.control: frozen arm: no encoder training, the configuration W3 passed at this dose

preconditions.name: pre_phase_identical_across_arms
preconditions.description: babbling + pre phase are byte-identical across arms within a seed (W6a trains only post)

preconditions.name: retained_babbling_set_frozen
preconditions.description: the W3 retained babbling set is unchanged after the post phase in every run

preconditions.name: retention_denominator_positive
preconditions.description: (b)'s pre-registered ratio (post - B0)/(pre - B0) is only interpretable when pre > B0; count of real runs with pre <= B0 (red-team F3; the formula itself is unchanged)

preconditions.name: all_runs_completed
preconditions.description: every B0 and (seed, arm, twin) run wrote its record

interpretation.what_a_null_does_not_mean: CANNOT_DETERMINE says the frozen control did not reach the W3 bar at this dose on these seeds, so no replay policy can be judged; it says nothing about re-encode vs stored. NEITHER says neither W3 replay policy keeps the L2R bar while W6a trains the encoder at 1 update per waking step for 1200 steps; it does not say a phased schedule (encoder frozen while W3 trains) fails. D1 only: no E3 consumer or behaviour is read. LEG (e) (amendment A1, red-team F1, stated before the run): in every W6a-ON run seen so far the rollout late-growth max exceeded 1.2 in BOTH the real arm and its label-permuted twin, while every frozen run passed; an (e) failure the twin shares reflects the trained encoder's latent space, which both W6a arms share, not the replay policy. So a NEITHER whose arms fail ONLY (e) (per_arm keeps_bar_excluding_e_secondary true, e_fail_twin_also_fails_e high) is a rollout-stability finding about the W6a encoder, not evidence that the buffer policy loses the L2R bar; the pre-registered verdict is still reported as computed.
interpretation.dv_symmetry: disc4/k are invariant to a uniform rescaling of the latent space, and W6a rescales z_world ~9x; the manipulation still reaches the DV through the head's TRAINING (stored z go stale, re-encoded z do not), not through the readout metric, and S1 (per-dimension standardised) reports whether any break is metric anisotropy. The shuf twin permutes action labels, which argmin-over-classes disc4 is NOT invariant to (it scores the true class).
